cases.name: read-input-plain
cases.note: Plain Winget install with a concrete version; the control for this file.

cases.name: read-input-operation-outside-set
cases.note: Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-operation-wrong-case
cases.note: Closed-set values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-manager-outside-set
cases.note: Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-manager-wrong-case
cases.note: Closed-set values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-source-name-empty
cases.note: Source.Name is 1 to 128 bytes.

cases.name: read-input-source-name-128-bytes-multibyte
cases.note: 64 times U+00E9, 2 bytes each in UTF-8: 128 bytes, 64 code points.

cases.name: read-input-source-name-129-bytes-65-code-points
cases.note: Lengths count UTF-8 bytes: 129 bytes although only 65 code points.

cases.name: read-input-source-url-2048-bytes
cases.note: Bun accepts this Source.Url (§manager-bun); the URL is https://www.npmjs.com followed by '/' up to 2048 bytes, which equals https://www.npmjs.com once trailing '/' are removed.

cases.name: read-input-source-url-2049-bytes
cases.note: Same as read-input-source-url-2048-bytes with one more '/': 2049 bytes.

cases.name: read-input-package-id-every-allowed-character
cases.note: Uses every allowed character. An uninstall, because under the default reading the last '@' selects a version (§package-identity).

cases.name: read-input-package-id-space
cases.note: A character outside the Package.Id set. Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-package-id-tilde
cases.note: A character outside the Package.Id set. Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-package-id-asterisk
cases.note: A character outside the Package.Id set. Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-package-id-backslash
cases.note: A character outside the Package.Id set. Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-package-id-equals
cases.note: A character outside the Package.Id set. Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-package-id-non-ascii
cases.note: A character outside the Package.Id set. Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-package-id-line-feed
cases.note: A character outside the Package.Id set. Control: read-input-plain.

cases.name: read-input-package-version-128-bytes
cases.note: '1' then 63 times '.0' then '0': 128 bytes, a concrete Winget version.

cases.name: read-input-architecture-wrong-case
cases.note: Control: read-input-architecture-x64.

cases.name: read-input-architecture-outside-set
cases.note: Control: read-input-architecture-x64.

cases.name: read-input-channel-empty
cases.note: Package.Channel is 1 to 16 bytes.

cases.name: read-input-channel-1-byte
cases.note: Under Winget a channel makes no request unreadable (§managers).

cases.name: read-input-channel-16-bytes-multibyte
cases.note: 8 times U+00E9: 16 bytes.

cases.name: read-input-channel-17-bytes-9-code-points
cases.note: 17 bytes although only 9 code points.

cases.name: read-input-scope-wrong-case
cases.note: Control: read-input-scope-machine.

cases.name: read-input-scope-outside-set
cases.note: Control: read-input-scope-machine.

cases.name: read-input-install-location-2048-bytes
cases.note: 'C:\' and one 2045-byte segment: a plain local path of 2048 bytes (§install-location).

cases.name: read-input-custom-parameters-64-elements
cases.note: Elements not starting with '-' have no Winget effect (§manager-winget).

cases.name: read-input-custom-parameter-512-bytes-multibyte
cases.note: 256 times U+00E9: 512 bytes.

cases.name: read-input-custom-parameter-empty
cases.note: Custom parameters are 1 to 512 bytes, and §reading also lists an empty one as unreadable. Control: read-input-custom-parameter-512-bytes.

cases.name: read-input-kill-element-empty
cases.note: Control: read-input-kill-element-128-bytes.

cases.name: read-input-requested-elevation-wrong-case
cases.note: Control: read-input-requested-elevation-elevated.

cases.name: read-input-requested-elevation-outside-set
cases.note: Control: read-input-requested-elevation-elevated.
